title: SK chief defends Samsung and SK's US$3.5 trillion investment plans

title: KYEC warns AI demand is amplifying semiconductor supply-chain risks
content: King Yuan Electronics (KYEC) president Gauss Chang said the AI era is creating new challenges for capacity expansion, as rapidly rising chip prices and shorter product cycles are reshaping the value of semiconductor testing. He also warned that demand can become increasingly distorted as it moves through the AI supply chain, making actual end-market demand difficult to assess.

content: Texas' incoming Democratic governor, Gina Hinojosa, plans to reassess the state's partnerships with the technology sector and strengthen oversight of data-center expansion, potentially reshaping policy for AI data centers and major technology companies. title: Chang Wah Technology holds high utilization, boosts China investment

title: Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron forge rare alliance to pave way for unmanned chip fabs
content: Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron are reportedly collaborating on charging standards for mobile robots used in semiconductor fabs, seeking to accelerate factory automation and lay the groundwork for unmanned manufacturing. The initiative is unusual as it brought together major industry rivals to standardise robotic components, equipment, communications and system interfaces, potentially drawing broader attention across the semiconductor industry.
